parameters.name: project
parameters.description: root prefix for output file names

parameters.name: dryrun
parameters.description: dryrun=True will only produce the informative report, not run simobserve/analyze

parameters.name: skymodel
parameters.description: model image to observe

parameters.name: inbright
parameters.description: scale surface brightness of brightest pixel e.g. "1.2Jy/pixel"

parameters.name: indirection
parameters.description: set new direction e.g. "J2000 19h00m00 -40d00m00"

parameters.name: incell
parameters.description: set new cell/pixel size e.g. "0.1arcsec"

parameters.name: incenter
parameters.description: set new frequency of center channel e.g. "89GHz" (required even for 2D model)

parameters.name: inwidth
parameters.description: set new channel width e.g. "10MHz" (required even for 2D model)

parameters.name: complist
parameters.description: componentlist to observe

parameters.name: compwidth
parameters.description: bandwidth of components

parameters.name: setpointings
parameters.description: If True, calculate a map of pointings and write *ptgfile*.

parameters.name: ptgfile
parameters.description: list of pointing positions

parameters.name: integration
parameters.description: integration (sampling) time

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: "J2000 19h00m00 -40d00m00" or "" to center on model

parameters.name: mapsize
parameters.description: angular size of map or "" to cover model

parameters.name: antennalist
parameters.description: antenna position files of ALMA 12m and 7m arrays

parameters.name: correlator
parameters.description: Name of the correlator, used to lookup the efficiency. Allowed options are based on

parameters.name: hourangle
parameters.description: hour angle of observation center e.g. -3:00:00, or "transit"

parameters.name: totaltime
parameters.description: total time of observation; vector corresponding to antennalist

parameters.name: tpnant
parameters.description: Number of total power antennas to use (0-4)

parameters.name: tptime
parameters.description: total observation time for total power

parameters.name: pwv
parameters.description: Precipitable Water Vapor in mm. 0 for noise-free simulation

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: image simulated data

parameters.name: imsize
parameters.description: output image size in pixels (x,y) or 0 to match model

parameters.name: imdirection
parameters.description: set output image direction, (otherwise center on the model)

parameters.name: cell
parameters.description: cell size with units or "" to equal model

parameters.name: niter
parameters.description: maximum number of iterations (0 for dirty image)

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: flux level (+units) to stop cleaning

parameters.name: graphics
parameters.description: display graphics at each stage to [screen|file|both|none]

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Print extra information to the logger and terminal.

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: overwrite files starting with $project
